cause_quote: The new focus renderer passed `.sessionKey=${focusTarget.sessionKey}` and `.fixedTab=${tab}` but omitted `.sessionTabs`, so the session-scoped tab list excluded the untracked startup tab.
user_saw: After a cold start, the Android Agent browser panel said the selected tab was unavailable even though it was still open.
summary: The browser focus page now sends the selected tab as an explicit reference in its session-scoped tab request.
reasoning: First-parent history shows that #159891 introduced session-scoped tab filtering before #159767 added the browser focus page used by Android. The introducing diff omits the tab reference, and the controller at that commit checks the fixed target against the already-filtered list, so the cold-start case was broken when the page shipped.
